Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 9480- 1980 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The elevator shall be free from cracks, seams, burrs and other surface defects. 

4.2 The elevator shall be Rnished smooth, matt finished and passivated. 

4.3 The handle shall be properly knurled for good grip. 

4.4 All edges shall be even and rounded. 

4.5 The elevator shall be accurately shaped without any sharp edges. 

5. Heat Treatment -The elevator shall be uniformly hardened and tempered to a hardness 
of 350 to 450 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Flexibility -Grip the elevator in a suitable vice so that the working end projects about 60 mm 
from the vice in the horizontal plane. Apply suitable force to the free end so that the shaft deflects 
by 5 mm as measured at the end in the horizontal plane, The elevator shall not show any sign of 
damage or permanent set after the test. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance — The elevator shall pass boiling and autoclaving test as specified in 
IS: 7531-1975 ' Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel 
surgical instruments'. 

7. Marking — The elevator shall be marked legibly and indelibly with the manufacturers name, initials 
or registered trade-mark. :. 

7.1 ISI Certification, Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. PuckiniJ — XfrC&fvators shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene bag 
avoiding c6htef6fvi/tlh oh'e'another. The elevators may also be packed as agreed to between the 
purchaser aridIM supplier.
